scope: Exact matched musical intervals, separated from admission and close counters. Not a whole-lifecycle zero-gap claim.

workload.phase: Saved Scene 1 note sequence and existing automation looping; both editors closed; no desktop input, screenshots, builds, downloads or external profiler during each interval.
workload.chain_excludes: DAW/device path; no physical latency measurement
workload.publication: ordinary exact revision 7, unchanged host/native artifacts; manager storage repair only

clocks.timestamps: Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC; before/after brackets enclose two sequential independent AP12 status reads and process CPU snapshots. Not a globally atomic multi-process snapshot.
clocks.cpu: Linux /proc/PID/stat utime+stime at HZ=100; exact PID and start-time pairing; percent of one core. No elapsed-minus-vendor scheduler inference.
clocks.windows: QPC stays separate; no cross-domain subtraction.

limitations: Before_off CPU role receipt was not captured; no aggregate CPU claim for that interval.
Bitwig application scope was 10000 at both ends of included intervals. Writer unknown; bridge service stayed unset/effective 100. No scheduling setting was changed as the repair.

Earlier trace-off interval with application-scope weight transitioning from unset to 10000 is excluded. Earlier before_on stopped-transport interval after failed remote input is excluded from musical comparison.
Full-session preparation histograms below have unequal lengths and are not an exact 90-second distribution comparison.
Trace-on/off CPU differences include ordinary variation and are not an isolated instrumentation-cost estimate. External bounded sampler overhead is separately retained in causal-baseline.json.
